comments.body: any remaining concerns on https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/608  for proposer preferences beacon api specs

I'd like to get a pulse on QUIC support on all clients and discuss https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5330

I know that Lighthouse recently merged this PR to [disable mplex by default](https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/9365). In the past, discussion here around mplex deprecation led to "go straight to QUIC" instead of embracing yamux. We should coordinate here to avoid network split.
